description: Four signal lines, each with a solo and an on switch that can be pressed or triggered

params.text: Silences the other three lines while it is on; its lamp blinks while it is on

inputs.text: A rise here turns that line on or off
A rise here turns that line's solo on or off

outputs.text: That line's signal, silent while the line is off or another line is soloed
